Ourark World Studio · optional integration

Cesium globe and free movement source

Cesium and the application code are included with their notices. The original Kronach models, height fields and hosted county tiles are excluded. This entry page makes no external requests.

The integration uses external imagery and terrain services; its data licenses, availability and provider terms are separate from the MIT code license. Read docs/INTEGRATIONS.md in the repository and configure the missing inputs before opening it. The original entry remains source for integrators, with its original dataset assumptions.

Open the self-contained Map Studio example, or open the globe integration after setup. Opening the integration contacts imagery and terrain providers; tiles=off disables county tiles, not all original model requests.
